topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Found out someone had the audacity to tattoo one of my pieces on their skin. Can you believe the nerve? I didn’t ink that canvas for it to end up as a permanent accessory on someone’s arm. What part of personal creation don’t people understand these days? It's bad enough to copy, but to etch it into flesh? There’s no way to take it back, no way to scrub away the arrogance of it. And what if they get tired of it? I’ve seen how people can ruin a good piece with botched cover-ups. My work deserves better, damn it.
